content.thinking:
I'm checking each overview claim against its source. The first says some shoppers couldn't load their account pages for a set duration, which matches what readers saw and the summary. The second ties the problem to a new feature that runs account pages through a monthly spending calculation, which likely fails for shoppers with no purchases this month; that's backed by the process notes and the first failure finding.

I'm working through the remaining overview claims against the record. The shop lost an estimated amount in takings, and nobody was paged or linked to an on-call incident. The switched-off feature was turned back on after that didn't help, and a fix has been proposed as a draft that isn't in place yet.

content.text: All seven claims in the overview are supported by the record, so I raised no flags. The overview has no went_wrong field to check for placement.
